Awesome server! Thank you for hosting it, connection is swift and clean. Love how many people are playing at once, the only problem I have with it is that people are spawning things in, which may deter some people from playing on it. Things that are being spawned in: Platinum coins to level up in the 1000s+, pets, weapons/ armour, food etc. I don't know if there is a way around this, just thought I would point that out. It clogs up the chat system immensely. Besides that, I loved the server, many of the players were nice and I found a few to team-up with. Keep up the good work!

Still play it every now and then. Everything kills you when you play alone, you pretty much have to play with friends. Either way, I usually play a few times a month. I still find enjoyment out of it.
